head.i: Cur aliquis tantum ex omnibus fortasse hac ratione servari poterat.

main_text.head: RESPOSIO.
main_text.p: Responsio ad unitas sed dignitas personæ spectan-da.Non tam unitate, quam dignitatem ejus personæ, quæ pro nobis satisfecit, non nos spectare oportet, ut appareat, non ex parte, sed plenissimè dissolutum esse totum debitum nostrum. Tanta enim est virtus & potetia Mediatoris nostri, Filii Dei, ut ei tyrannis peccati & Satanæ resistere nō possit: cum tamē potentia Satanæ & vis peccati tanta sit, ut adversus illam nulla virtus humana, imò nec angelica quidē, aliquid præstare possit.
Christus enim quia verus Deus & homo est, ad nos redimendum habuitAt alterum negant Adversarii. I. Ius proprietatis. & jus proprietatis, & jus ꝓpinquitatis.

Proprietatis in nos jus habet Christus tanquam verus Deus. Nisi certè verus Deus esset, hoc modo Servator noster non esset. Necesse quidem est, ut coram Deo inveniatur ꝓportio inter peccatū & peccati pœnam. page.notes: Top-right number "338" is a heavier, non-printed number (likely a library or manuscript number), so it was not transcribed; the printed page number is 341. The first line of italic text above RESPOSIO has its initial letter cut off at the left edge, so it begins as a fragment ("ur" visible). The marginal note "Responsio ad" and "spectan-da" are partly faint and may need checking. In the note "I. Ius proprietatis" the hyphenation at the line end is unclear. The heading "RESPOSIO." is copied as printed (the N appears to be missing in the scan). The printed "ꝓpinquitatis" and "ꝓportio" use the pro abbreviation, transcribed as such. Long s has been rendered as plain s throughout. Spelling "potetia" and "verus" is copied as printed.
